entities.name: Nassari
entities.description: An efreet shaman, dean of the Prismari College at Strixhaven, compleated in the invasion but restored by the Invocation of the Founders.

entities.name: Prismari College
entities.description: College of Strixhaven led by Nassari.

entities.name: Uvilda Mistcoiler
entities.description: Quiet artist at Prismari whom Nassari often forgets.

entities.name: Rootha Squallheart
entities.description: Orc whom Nassari helped express her unique magic.

entities.name: Quintorius Kand
entities.description: Completed the Invocation of the Founders.

entities.name: Invocation of the Founders
entities.description: Spell that restored Nassari and other compleated professors.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion during which Nassari was compleated.

events.summary: Nassari is compleated early in the New Phyrexian Invasion and appears as a giant mechanical heart.
events.quote: had been compleated earlier in the invasion

events.summary: Once Quintorius Kand completes the spell, Nassari is thrown from the rooftop, but the Invocation restores their elemental body entirely.
events.quote: Nassari's elemental body was able to be restored in its entirety by the Invocation

relations.note: Helped her express her unique magic.
relations.quote: helping the orc to express her unique magic
